claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black Nikon DSLR with a large lens, but the exact model (D610) and condition details are not readable/confirmed from the provided angles.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears.
claims.evidence: The report does not clearly document scratches/dents/cracks; only general appearance is described.
No accessories (battery/charger/memory card) are shown in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (not actually D610), which changes value significantly.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera model text/label (e.g., on the body) and/or the menu “About/Model” screen showing “D610”.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified Nikon DSLR (worst-case: not D610) with unknown specs.

risks.risk: Not fully working (shutter, autofocus, buttons/ports, rear LCD, exposure/metering).
risks.proof: A short video showing: power on, menu navigation, live view, autofocus lock on a target, and a test shot saved to memory card (with playback).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/working and treat as higher risk for repairs.

risks.risk: Lens issues (fungus/haze, scratches, aperture not functioning) affecting image quality.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of lens glass (front and rear) under light + a video demonstrating aperture changes (or shooting at different apertures and showing results).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens condition unknown; assume possible haze/scratches.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, cables) or non-original parts.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo/video of all included items with labels (battery model, charger model) and the battery inserted in the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal/uncertain accessories (worst-case: battery/charger not guaranteed).

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy usage leading to earlier failure.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of shutter count from the camera or a connected app (or a service/usage report).
risks.if_unproven: Price as high usage/unknown shutter count.

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage (cracked screen, dents, damaged ports) that reduces resale value.
risks.proof: Straight-on close-ups of: rear LCD, hot shoe area, all ports (USB/HDMI), buttons/dials, and corners/edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible cosmetic wear with no confirmed damage severity.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact camera model (D610) label or the “About/Model” screen.
Video test: power on → menu navigation → live view → autofocus lock → take a photo → playback on the rear LCD.
Close-up photos of lens front/rear glass for fungus/haze/scratches, plus a quick aperture test (shoot at different f-stops).
Photos/video of all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, memory card, cables) with visible labels.
Shutter count screenshot/photo (from camera/app) or any usage/service record.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nikon DSLR, but the exact model (D610) and working condition/accessories are not verifiable from the provided angles. Without a proof shot for model and basic functionality, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
